content.title: About
content.content: Sweetened almond milk is made from ground almonds, water and added sugar (or another sweetener). It has a mild nutty flavor, light sweetness and a creamy texture, suitable for vegans and people who are lactose intolerant.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Almond milk became popular as an alternative beverage in the 1990s when the U.S. vegan movement gained momentum.
Sweetened versions often use cane sugar, maple syrup or fruit juice to add sweetness.
Almonds belong to the Rosaceae family and are more closely related to peaches than to true nuts.
Almond milk contains fewer calories than cow's milk, but sweetened versions have higher sugar content.
Unlike cow's milk, almond milk naturally contains no cholesterol.

items.title: Rich in vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E is a powerful antioxidant that protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Most of the fat in almond milk is monounsaturated, which is heart‑friendly.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Sweetened varieties are often fortified with calcium to support bone health.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Almond milk contains a small amount of dietary fiber that can aid regular digestion.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Completely free of lactose, making it suitable for people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: People allergic to almonds or other tree nuts may experience severe reactions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sweetened versions can contain significant amounts of sugar, which is undesirable for diabetics or those watching their weight.

items.title: Low protein
items.content: Compared with cow's milk, almond milk provides little protein, so it shouldn't be relied on as a primary protein source.

items.title: Additives and flavorings
items.content: Some brands use artificial flavors and stabilizers that may cause sensitivity in certain individuals.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Sweetened almond milk is great as a refreshing drink, added to coffee, tea, smoothies, oatmeal, baked goods, or used in sauces and desserts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator after opening and consume within 5‑7 days. Unopened cartons can be kept in a cool, dry place until the printed expiration date.
